entry.en: The passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: El pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: Cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more must be declared.
entry.es: El efectivo o los cheques de viaje por un valor de 10.000 euros o más deben declararse.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: At Swedish border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo sueco quizá tengas que mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: Children aged 17 and under travelling with you should carry a letter of consent from their parent or guardian.
entry.es: Los menores de 17 años o menos que viajen contigo deben llevar una carta de consentimiento de su padre, madre o tutor.
entry.quote: Carry a letter of consent from the parent or guardian of children aged 17 and under who are travelling with you.

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Al entrar en el espacio Schengen para estancias cortas quizá debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas dactilares y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo.

entry.en: Border controls are in place for travellers from Denmark via the Öresund crossing and on ferries from Denmark and Germany.
entry.es: Hay controles fronterizos para quienes llegan de Dinamarca por el puente de Öresund y en los ferris desde Dinamarca y Alemania.
entry.quote: Border controls are in place in Sweden for people travelling from Denmark via the Öresund crossing and arriving on ferries from Denmark and Germany.

safety.en: Pickpockets often target tourists for passports and cash in major cities.
safety.es: Los carteristas suelen buscar pasaportes y dinero de los turistas en las grandes ciudades.
safety.quote: Take particular care of your belongings in major cities as pickpockets often target tourists for passports and cash.

safety.en: Gang-related crime, including knife crime, shootings and explosions, has been reported in Malmö, Stockholm and Gothenburg.
safety.es: Se han registrado delitos de bandas, incluidos apuñalamientos, tiroteos y explosiones, en Malmö, Estocolmo y Gotemburgo.
safety.quote: Violent crime does occur. Gang-related crime, including knife crime, shootings and explosions, has been reported in Malmö, Stockholm and Gothenburg.

safety.en: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Sweden.
safety.es: Es probable que los terroristas intenten cometer atentados en Suecia.
safety.quote: Terrorists are likely to try to carry out attacks in Sweden.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are strictly prohibited even in small quantities.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, están estrictamente prohibidas incluso en pequeñas cantidades.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are strictly prohibited, even in small quantities.

safety.en: From 1 December to 31 March all vehicles must have winter tyres.
safety.es: Del 1 de diciembre al 31 de marzo todos los vehículos deben llevar neumáticos de invierno.
safety.quote: During winter, snow and ice on the roads cause accidents daily. From 1 December to 31 March, and any other times designated by the police, all vehicles must have winter tyres.

safety.en: Carrying knives in public areas is criminalised, except blunt or very small knives or when needed for work or outdoor life.
safety.es: Llevar cuchillos en lugares públicos es delito, salvo los romos o muy pequeños o si se necesitan para el trabajo o la vida al aire libre.
safety.quote: Knife-carrying in public areas is criminalised (except blunt or very small knives) unless needed for work, outdoor life, or other activities.

health.quote: Dial 112 and ask for an ambulance.

health.en: A GHIC or EHIC is needed to get medically necessary state healthcare in Sweden.
health.es: Se necesita una tarjeta GHIC o EHIC para recibir la atención sanitaria pública médicamente necesaria en Suecia.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Sweden, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Travel insurance should cover local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: El seguro de viaje debe cubrir el tratamiento local o una evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

health.en: Tap water in Sweden is of great quality and contains close to zero bacteria.
health.es: El agua del grifo en Suecia es de excelente calidad y contiene casi cero bacterias.
health.quote: Tap water in Sweden is of great quality, and contains close to zero bacteria.

health.en: Ticks appear in summer, especially in tall grass, and can transmit Lyme disease and tick-borne encephalitis.
health.es: Las garrapatas aparecen en verano, sobre todo en la hierba alta, y pueden transmitir la enfermedad de Lyme y la encefalitis transmitida por garrapatas.
health.quote: Ticks (fästingar) appear in summer, especially in tall grass. They can transmit Lyme's disease (borreliosis) and TBE (tick-borne encephalitis) through a bite.

health.en: Call 112 for emergencies and 1177 for non-emergency medical consulting and directions to open clinics.
health.es: Llama al 112 para emergencias y al 1177 para consultas médicas no urgentes e indicaciones de clínicas abiertas.
health.quote: Call 112 for emergencies, and 1177 for non-emergency medical consulting, as well as directions for open medical clinics.

help.en: The emergency number for ambulance, fire and police is 112.
help.es: El número de emergencias para ambulancia, bomberos y policía es el 112.

help.en: 112 works on any mobile phone, with or without a SIM card, even if it is keylocked.
help.es: El 112 funciona en cualquier móvil, con o sin tarjeta SIM, incluso bloqueado.
help.quote: The number works on any mobile phone, with or without a SIM card, even if it's keylocked

help.en: To report a theft or contact the police in general there is a national non-emergency number, 114 14.
help.es: Para denunciar un robo o contactar con la policía hay un número nacional no urgente, el 114 14.
help.quote: there is a national non-emergency phone number 114 14 that will bring you in contact with an operator at a police station

help.en: After a serious incident or emergency abroad, contact your travel provider and your insurer.
help.es: Tras un incidente grave o una emergencia en el extranjero, contacta con tu proveedor de viaje y tu aseguradora.
help.quote: Contact your travel provider and your insurer if you are involved in a serious incident or emergency abroad.

getting_in.en: Stockholm Arlanda is Sweden's main airport, 40 km from the centre of Stockholm.
getting_in.es: Estocolmo-Arlanda es el aeropuerto principal de Suecia, a 40 km del centro de Estocolmo.
getting_in.quote: Stockholm Arlanda (ARN IATA) is Sweden's main airport, 40 km (25 mi) from the centre of Stockholm

getting_in.en: Göteborg Landvetter, 25 km from Gothenburg, has flights from most major European airports.
getting_in.es: Göteborg Landvetter, a 25 km de Gotemburgo, tiene vuelos desde la mayoría de los grandes aeropuertos europeos.
getting_in.quote: Göteborg Landvetter (GOT IATA), 25 km (16 mi) from Gothenburg in southern Sweden, has flights from most major European airports.

getting_in.en: Stockholm Skavsta is mainly served by budget airlines such as Ryanair and Wizzair.
getting_in.es: Stockholm-Skavsta lo usan sobre todo aerolíneas de bajo coste como Ryanair y Wizzair.
getting_in.quote: Stockholm Skavsta (NYO IATA) is mainly served by budget airlines like Ryanair and Wizzair, with many connections to Europe, especially the Balkans.

getting_in.en: Most airports can be reached by Flygbussarna airport coaches for around 70-120 kr.
getting_in.es: A la mayoría de los aeropuertos se llega con los autobuses Flygbussarna por unos 70-120 kr.
getting_in.quote: Most airports can be reached by the airport coaches of Flygbussarna for around 70–120 kr, but some are well served also by normal public transport.

getting_in.en: Trains run from Copenhagen and its airport to Malmö every 20 minutes for about 100 Swedish kronor.
getting_in.es: Hay trenes de Copenhague y su aeropuerto a Malmö cada 20 minutos por unas 100 coronas suecas.
getting_in.quote: Trains depart Copenhagen and Copenhagen's airport for Malmö every 20 minutes, and cost only about 100 Swedish kronor

getting_in.en: Direct overnight trains run daily from Berlin to Stockholm via Hamburg and Malmö, operated by SJ.
getting_in.es: Hay trenes nocturnos directos diarios de Berlín a Estocolmo vía Hamburgo y Malmö, operados por SJ.
getting_in.quote: Direct overnight trains run daily from Berlin to Stockholm via Hamburg and Malmö, operated by SJ

getting_around.en: Most long-range rail lines in Sweden are operated by the government-owned company SJ.
getting_around.es: La mayoría de las líneas ferroviarias de larga distancia en Suecia las opera la empresa estatal SJ.
getting_around.quote: Sweden has an extensive railway network. Most long-range lines are operated by the government-owned company SJ.

getting_around.en: Train tickets bought online in advance are usually cheaper, at the expense of flexibility.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de tren comprados por internet con antelación suelen ser más baratos, a costa de la flexibilidad.
getting_around.quote: Tickets bought online in advance are usually cheaper, at the expense of flexibility.

getting_around.en: In many Swedish cities city-bus tickets cannot be bought on the bus.
getting_around.es: En muchas ciudades suecas no se pueden comprar los billetes del autobús urbano en el propio autobús.
getting_around.quote: In many Swedish cities it is not possible to buy tickets for the city buses at the bus.

getting_around.en: On long-distance buses passengers can normally buy tickets from the driver.
getting_around.es: En los autobuses de larga distancia normalmente se puede comprar el billete al conductor.
getting_around.quote: On long distance buses, passengers can normally buy tickets from the driver.

getting_around.en: Moose, deer and boar are commonly on the road, especially around dawn and dusk, and collisions are a major danger.
getting_around.es: Alces, ciervos y jabalíes suelen estar en la carretera, sobre todo al amanecer y al anochecer, y las colisiones son un peligro importante.
getting_around.quote: Animal collisions with moose, deer and boar are a major danger; these animals are commonly on the road, especially around dawn and dusk.

getting_around.en: Drunk driving is a serious crime with strictly enforced laws and harsh punishments.
getting_around.es: Conducir ebrio es un delito grave, con leyes que se aplican estrictamente y castigos severos.
getting_around.quote: Drunk driving is a serious crime, the laws are strictly enforced, and the punishments are harsh by international standards.

money.en: The national currency is the Swedish krona (SEK), abbreviated kr.
money.es: La moneda nacional es la corona sueca (SEK), abreviada kr.
money.quote: The national currency is the Swedish krona (plural,: kronor), denoted by the abbreviation "kr" (ISO code: SEK).

money.en: Sweden is one of the world's most cashless countries and a card-centric country.
money.es: Suecia es uno de los países con menos uso de efectivo del mundo y se basa en las tarjetas.
money.quote: Sweden is one of the world's most cashless countries and a card-centric country.

money.en: Tipping is not customary, but a tip is sometimes left for good service, usually by rounding up the bill.
money.es: La propina no es costumbre, pero a veces se deja por buen servicio, normalmente redondeando la cuenta.
money.quote: Tipping, known as dricks in Swedish, is not customary in Sweden, but sometimes a tip is left as a sign of appreciation for good service, usually by rounding up the bill

money.en: Stores are not to be expected to accept foreign currency, except near the borders where the neighbouring currency is usually accepted.
money.es: No se debe esperar que las tiendas acepten divisas extranjeras, salvo cerca de las fronteras, donde suele aceptarse la moneda vecina.
money.quote: Don't expect stores to accept foreign currency, apart from close to the borders, where usually only the neighbour currency is accepted (i.e. Danish krone, Norwegian krone or euro).

money.en: Banknotes and coins older than 2017 are no longer valid, with an exception for the latest 10 kronor coin.
money.es: Los billetes y monedas anteriores a 2017 ya no son válidos, salvo la última moneda de 10 coronas.
money.quote: Banknotes and coins older than 2017 are no longer valid, except for the latest type of the 10 kronor coin (year 1991 to 2009).

money.en: The Swish payment app is commonly used but requires a Swedish bank account.
money.es: La aplicación de pago Swish se usa mucho, pero requiere una cuenta bancaria sueca.
money.quote: The domestic payment smartphone app Swish is commonly used, but it requires a Swedish bank account.

etiquette.en: In most homes it is customary to remove your shoes.
etiquette.es: En la mayoría de los hogares es costumbre quitarse los zapatos.
etiquette.quote: In most homes it is customary to remove your shoes.

etiquette.en: Show up on the minute for meetings and meals, as there is no fashionably late in Sweden.
etiquette.es: Llega puntual a reuniones y comidas, ya que en Suecia no existe llegar tarde con elegancia.
etiquette.quote: Show up on the minute for meetings and meals, preferably five minutes before the set time. There is no "fashionably late" in Sweden.

etiquette.en: Swedish people want and expect privacy and personal space.
etiquette.es: Los suecos desean y esperan privacidad y espacio personal.
etiquette.quote: Swedish people want and expect privacy and personal space.

etiquette.en: Swedish people are generally not accepting of public nudity except at designated nudist beaches.
etiquette.es: Los suecos en general no aceptan la desnudez pública salvo en playas nudistas designadas.
etiquette.quote: Swedish people are generally not accepting of public nudity except at designated nudist beaches.

etiquette.en: Most Swedes, old and young, are strongly opposed to narcotics.
etiquette.es: La mayoría de los suecos, mayores y jóvenes, se oponen firmemente a los narcóticos.
etiquette.quote: most Swedes, old and young, are strongly opposed to them.

etiquette.en: Sweden is quite tolerant about homosexuality and same-sex marriages have legal standing.
etiquette.es: Suecia es bastante tolerante con la homosexualidad y los matrimonios del mismo sexo tienen validez legal.
etiquette.quote: Sweden is quite tolerant about homosexuality. Same-sex marriages have legal standing in Sweden.

connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico internacional de Suecia es +46.
connectivity.quote: Sweden's international calling code number is +46.

connectivity.en: Since 2022 all Swedish prepaid SIMs must be registered with a personnummer, a BankID or valid photo ID before use.
connectivity.es: Desde 2022 todas las SIM de prepago suecas deben registrarse con un personnummer, un BankID o un documento con foto válido antes de usarse.
connectivity.quote: Since 2022, all Swedish prepaid SIMs need to be registered to a person with a Swedish personnummer, a BankID, or valid photo ID (passport or identity card) before they can be used.

connectivity.en: Prepaid SIM cards are sold at Pressbyrån outlets, most supermarkets and tobacconists.
connectivity.es: Las SIM de prepago se venden en los puntos Pressbyrån, la mayoría de los supermercados y los estancos.
connectivity.quote: Prepaid SIM cards (kontantkort) and refills are sold at the Pressbyrån outlets, as well as at most supermarkets and tobacconists.

connectivity.en: A SIM from another EU/EEA country may keep working in Sweden, subject to fair-use limits.
connectivity.es: Una SIM de otro país de la UE/EEE podría seguir funcionando en Suecia, sujeta a límites de uso razonable.
connectivity.quote: If you already have a SIM from another EU/EEA country, you may be able to continue using it in Sweden, subject to any fair-use limits imposed by your home provider.

connectivity.en: 3G has been completely shut down by all operators in Sweden.
connectivity.es: Todos los operadores de Suecia han apagado por completo el 3G.
connectivity.quote: 3G has already been completely shut down by all operators.

connectivity.en: Fast food chains, libraries, hotels, cafés and malls may offer free Wi-Fi.
connectivity.es: Cadenas de comida rápida, bibliotecas, hoteles, cafés y centros comerciales pueden ofrecer wifi gratis.
connectivity.quote: Fast food chains, libraries, hotels, cafés and malls and others may offer free Wi-Fi access.
